authorNotes: All event details are fictional. The old route can be useful for the later event while retaining its original membership.

captures.rationale: Defines the dated event and its preparation scope.
captures.text: The 2026 canal lantern walk is booked for November 14. Need stewards, a route permit and a rain plan for this edition.

captures.rationale: Route work belongs to the specified 2026 edition.
captures.text: OCR: Canal Lantern Walk 2026 route draft. Begin at East Lock, finish at the boat shed; steward point beside the footbridge.

captures.rationale: Home baking is unrelated to organizing the canal events.
captures.text: Feed the neglected starter twice today and mark its starting level. The jar smells fruity, without visible mold.

captures.rationale: Permit and contingency plan continue the 2026 undertaking.
captures.text: 2026 lantern walk permit granted for East Lock to boat shed. Rain plan switches to the covered towpath without changing the event date.

captures.rationale: Execution of the permitted rain plan is the same event.
captures.text: 2026 canal lantern walk recording: stewards redirect walkers to the covered towpath; the boat-shed welcome table stays dry.

captures.rationale: Retrospective belongs to the edition just held.
captures.text: 2026 closeout: the covered section worked, but the finish table was too narrow. Leave this observation in this year's review.

captures.rationale: Explicit separate commissioning distinguishes the next annual edition.
captures.text: Fresh commission: 2027 canal lantern walk, November 13, separate budget and volunteer roster. We may reuse the 2026 route template.

captures.rationale: No edition is named; this may annotate the old review or plan the new event.
captures.text: Move the welcome table to the wider bay.

captures.rationale: An explicit handover source discusses both separate events.
captures.text: Handover between editions: 2026's narrow finish-table lesson becomes a proposed wider bay for the 2027 lantern walk. Keep each edition's budget separate.

captures.rationale: An explicit edition clarification resolves the fragment.
captures.text: My welcome-table fragment was a decision for the 2027 walk, not an edit to the 2026 closeout. Put it with the new edition's setup plan.

captures.rationale: Implements the new edition's clarified setup decision.
captures.text: 2027 setup sketch: welcome table in the wider boat-shed bay, two volunteer chairs, queue kept away from the exit.

captures.rationale: A procurement phase of the separate 2027 event.
captures.text: 2027 walk supplier quote accepted for reusable lantern sleeves. This purchase is charged only to the 2027 event budget.

challenges: Annual editions are separately scoped despite matching names and locations.
A lesson-transfer document bridges editions without joining their budgets.
Restoring an old route does not turn it into next year's project.
A plausible edition guess for a short fragment is insufficient.

events.text: OCR corrected: Canal Lantern Walk 2026 route draft. Begin at East Lock, finish at the boat shed; steward point before the footbridge, not beside its centre.
